Greek modern pentathlete (born 1976)

Katalin Partics (born October 22, 1976) is a Greek modern pentathlete.[1] She competed in the women's individual modern pentathlon events at the 2000 Summer Olympics, in which she placed 22nd, and the 2004 Summer Olympics, in which she placed 16th.[2][3][4]
